description: An interface for building log entry objects with a fluent API, defining various setters for log properties and a build method.

classes.name: LogEntryBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface for creating LogEntry instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: correlationId
methods.description: Sets the correlation ID for the log entry.

methods.name: timestamp
methods.description: Sets the timestamp of the log entry.

methods.name: logCategory
methods.description: Sets the category of the log entry.

methods.name: logType
methods.description: Sets the type of the log entry.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Sets the message of the log entry.

methods.name: address
methods.description: Sets the address related to the log, if available.

methods.name: thingId
methods.description: Sets the Thing ID related to the log, if available.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the LogEntry object based on the provided data.
